sampler: existing symmetric Dirichlet importance-mixture control variate
warnings: This is not a lower bound, upper bound, certificate, or global optimum.
The published BGP212 coefficient vector was unavailable, so calibration uses only its reported scalar quotient.
The restricted top-eight space can miss legal-support directions; larger projected spaces were numerically less stable in the current estimator.
Paired order-of-magnitude differences are more meaningful than individual Monte Carlo values.
